Dear chos✏️Illustrator (Comms Open)

Dear chos✏️Illustrator (Comms Open), Nice to meet you.
My name is Iroha Utage, and I am an individual VTuber. My name is Iroha Utage. Thank you very much for your compliments on my appeal and appearance. I am very happy!

I would like to request an illustration of my name.

The contents of your request
Illustration of me, Ayaha Banquet

I would appreciate it if you could draw me in a pose that is easy to draw in chos✏️Illustrator (Comms Open), as well as any costumes that you would like to draw. There is also a small animal in the material that serves as a chaperone, but it is up to chos✏️Illustrator (Comms Open) to decide whether or not he/she will draw it.
Important: There are two blacks around the eyes and teeth that are the charm point of the animal.

Intended use.
Use in SNS such as Twitter (X) (icons, headers, posts, etc.)
For use in YouTube and other streaming services, as thumbnails, etc.
Use on Twitch and other social networking sites (icons, headers, posts, etc.)
(Use on channels where none of the content is monetized.)
(Commercial use such as merchandising is not allowed.)

Others
We would like to use the image for various purposes, so if possible, it would be very helpful if the top, left, right, etc. are not cut off...!
It would be greatly appreciated if you could separate the person, background, signature, etc. into separate layers, or deliver a transparent background for the person only.
(We would appreciate it if you could deliver the image in PSD format.)

We understand that you are very busy, but we would appreciate your consideration.

Saiha Banquet
